method.fit_population: all training-fold pixels; every 128x128 image contributes equally
method.tie_handling: aggregate identical stored float32 probabilities by target mean and pixel count before deterministic PAV fit

regions.lesion_centered: reference mask plus Euclidean radius 8 model pixels

metrics: image-balanced NLL and Brier; 15 equal-frequency pooled-pixel ECE and MCE; per-category metrics

gate.hard_mask_changes: reported but not a C03 gate condition

hard_mask_check: bitwise compare raw_probability >= 0.50 with OOF_calibrated_probability >= 0.50; report changed pixels and images overall and by category
reference_mask_policy: reference masks provide calibration targets and evaluation regions during development; the fitted inference mapping accepts probability only and never receives a reference mask
